title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

errors: No outright error. The conclusion L = Y_{∂X} is consistent: (iii) forces Y∩∂X ⊂ L, and (ii) gives L ⊂ ∂X. The exact meaning depends on undefined primitives (≪, Omb, ⊓), so full verification is impossible from this page.

Formal gap: condition (iii) quantifies over Z in the shadow of Y and only approximates 'Y∖L is separated from ∂X'. Whether figures disjoint from L exhaust Y∖L is precisely the question raised in the closing remark, which is left unfinished.

ideas.what: Relative axiom: a sub-figure meeting the boundary exactly in a well-placed boundary piece is well placed (Y ≪ X with L = Y_{∂X})
ideas.modern_name: neat / proper sub-object; subcomplex compatible with the boundary stratification
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore in PL and stratified topology (e.g. neat embeddings in manifold theory)
ideas.where_published: Only the general programme of tame topology appears in Esquisse d'un programme (1984), §5-6; this axiomatics is unpublished.

ideas.what: Extending the separation relation ∥ to 'virtual' locally closed pieces Y∖L, Z∖K, so that ≪ becomes definable non-recursively from ≤ and ∥
ideas.modern_name: passing from closed definable sets to the Boolean algebra of constructible / locally closed definable sets (as in o-minimal structures)
ideas.usually_credited_to: o-minimality: van den Dries, Pillay–Steinhorn, Knight (1984–98); semialgebraic geometry: Łojasiewicz, Hironaka

missed.claim: Grothendieck conjectures that the 'well-placed' relation ≪ admits a non-recursive definition from ≤ and an extended separation relation on locally closed pieces. He leaves the construction unfinished.
missed.quote: Ceci suggère qu'il doit exister une définition non récursive de la relation ≪, dans M, au moyen de ≤ et de la relation ∥_M
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a modest point about axiomatising tame topology through order and disjointness relations. The idea resembles mereotopology or region-based axiomatisations. It would interest someone reconstructing his axiomatic tame topology, but in modern o-minimal practice it is subsumed by working with all definable sets.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a technical refinement of a provisional axiom, plus a methodological remark about needing virtual relations on locally closed pieces. It documents unpublished details of the 1986 axiomatics, but the mathematical content is natural and largely subsumed by o-minimal / constructible-set frameworks.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 likely reads 'Remarque On peut renforcer un peu l'Axiome 1 ainsi :' rather than 'L'on peut renforcer[?] : une forme[?] Axiome 1 ainsi'.
'Soient X, Y, L ∈ M, avec L ≤ Y': the inserted {+𝓛+} is spurious; L is written over a crossed-out letter.
In (iii), 'Z ∈ Amb(Y)' is probably 'Z ∈ Omb(Y)' (shadow, consistent with the neighbouring pages), and 'Z ∩ L' may be 'Z ⊓ L'.
'AtC (spec)' is likely 'ArC (spec)' (cf. ArL2, ArL3 on the next page).
'mais circonscrite[?] l'énoncé[?] de' should read approximately 'mais circonscrite à coups de S ≪ Y∖L, T ≪ Z∖K tels que...'.
